name: A profile
source:
Beneath the scorching sun of midsummer, a pampered, aloof sort of girl declared that there are four windows through which to view a person.

She was not the only one by his side, for he'd had a wounded girl thrust upon him - a wounded girl who could not help but depend upon him, as the girl he had known for so long once had. 

Now, however, that old friend of his vanishes in the dead of night to prowl where an ordinary girl should not.

The blue sky of the stadium and the filth of the city streets spread out before him; unsustainable aspirations and an unsustainable love beset him.

What in the world is he thinking as he gazes at their profiles?

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=225185]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
盛夏灼热的阳光下，一名娇生惯养、性格冷淡的少女声称，观察一个人共有四扇窗口。

陪伴在他身边的并不只有她。他还被托付照顾一名受伤的少女；那名少女无法不依赖他，就像他认识多年的另一个少女曾经那样。

然而如今，那位旧友总在深夜消失，出没于普通少女本不该前往的地方。

体育场的蓝天与城市街道的污秽同时铺展在他眼前；无法维系的理想与无法维系的爱情一同困扰着他。

凝望她们的侧脸时，他究竟在思考什么？

[翻译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=225185]Getchu[/url]]
